name: Onboarding & Updates
description: Welcomes newcomers with group rules and a guide to available commands. Administrators publish editions that members can read with /updates or subscribe to receive privately.
dataStored: Account-scoped SQLite records for welcomes, late-welcome queues, scope edition drafts and published text, per-member subscription choices and confirmed delivery progress.
privacyNotes: Member digests are private and opt-in for each community. The host checks current membership and standing before delivery. Welcomes and updates use WABP delivery and require no external HTTP provider.

assistant.summary: Welcomes people once, on their first arrival in a scope (a community or standalone groups): a private welcome with the rules, a guide built from /help, and an optional account invitation.
useCases: Welcome newcomers privately, once per scope, never again when they join another group of it.
Show the rules with /rules.
Preview the welcome or send it again to someone.
Once, send a paced late welcome to everyone who was here before onboarding started.
prerequisites: Groups in ASSIST or MANAGE mode, so the bot may send messages.
WABP core API 0.3.25 or later for the guide and the linked-account check.
limitations: Current members are recorded when it starts and are never welcomed.
People added back by the bot (for example after a suspension) get nothing.
Group history is sent separately, per group, by Send Group History.
